subject: PO formatting & invoice cadence for BigBank - proposal and exceptions
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@bigbank.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@bigbank.com
Date: 2026-09-03T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: PO details + invoicing cadence (BigBank PO process)

Vivek —

Thanks for taking this on. Procurement needs to finalize how Redwood will appear on our invoices and the cadence for payment. A few constraints from our side:

- We require the PO number on the invoice header and as the first line item description.
- BigBank pays on Net60 standard across vendors; exceptions require a commercial justification and approval.
- Preferred invoicing cadence for platform vendors is weekly consolidated batches (one invoice per week per vendor) rather than per-deployment invoices.
- For onboarding/one-time professional services fees, BU Procurement prefers a separate invoice so it can be coded to a capital project.
- Please provide your remit address, billing contact, and an up-to-date W-9.

Can Redwood accept weekly consolidated invoices (with PO number on each), and issue the onboarding invoice separately? Also, can you confirm invoice line-item labeling so our AP automation can map correctly?

If you need a sample PO template, I can send one. Looking to close this before our exec signoff next week.

Thanks —
Samantha Price
Senior Procurement Manager, BigBank
Samantha.Price@bigbank.com

Attachments referenced: none (we will attach PO once format confirmed)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@bigbank.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details + invoicing cadence (BigBank PO process)

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: we can do weekly consolidated invoices with the PO on the header, and we can issue a separate invoice for the onboarding/professional services line. A couple of notes/asks from our side so AP can match correctly:

- Invoice header must include: vendor name (Redwood Inference), vendor tax ID (we'll attach W-9), remit address, and the BigBank PO number as a top-level field.
- For weekly batches we need you to confirm whether you want all usage lines consolidated into one invoice (single total) or one invoice with multiple line-items per deployment/route. We typically produce one invoice with itemized line-lines by Redwood route (model+environment) which works well with our billing system.
- Standard Redwood payment terms are Net30. For enterprise procurement we can be flexible: we can extend to Net45 for the first year on platform usage if that helps close, but onboarding professional services must be invoiced separately and is usually Net30.

I'm attaching a draft SOW that lists the onboarding fee and the recommended invoice description strings we prefer (examples at the top of the SOW). If you can send a sample PO template, we will map our invoice output to match your required fields.

If Procurement agrees to Net45 for recurring usage, we can offer a small one-time credit (applied to the first invoice) to offset the extended term — happy to discuss numbers if that's required.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_BigBank.pdf (stub)

From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@bigbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@bigbank.com
Date: 2026-09-04T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details + invoicing cadence (BigBank PO process)

Vivek —

Thanks for the quick reply and the SOW. A couple follow-ups from procurement after reviewing internally:

- BigBank policy baseline is Net60. We can approve Net45 only with a commercial concession (we typically request a 1.5–2% early-payment/term discount for vendors who agree to Net30).
- For weekly consolidated invoices: AP wants one invoice per vendor per week, with itemized line-items (that is, a single PDF per week that lists all charges). That aligns with your 'one invoice with line-items' approach — good.
- On the onboarding invoice: we can accept it separately and route to the capital project, provided the invoice header explicitly includes the project code and the PO references the capital project number.

Could Redwood consider the following compromise so we can move forward quickly:
- Recurring platform invoices: Net45, weekly consolidated PDFs;
- Onboarding/pro services invoice (single invoice): Net30;
- If Redwood will accept Net45 for recurring, BigBank will not request a discount. If Redwood insists on Net30 for recurring, Procurement will request a 2% discount as part of the terms.

Please confirm which path you prefer; if you agree, we'll prepare the PO and provide the exact project code to place in the onboarding invoice header.

Best,
Samantha

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@bigbank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details + invoicing cadence (BigBank PO process)

Hi Samantha —

Looping in from commercial/legal to propose an operationally simple compromise that preserves Redwood's unit economics while meeting procurement controls:

Option A (preferred by Redwood):
- Recurring platform invoices: Net45 (weekly consolidated PDF).
- Onboarding/pro services: single invoice, Net30; invoice must include the provided project code and PO reference.
- Redwood will apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to 1.5% of the onboarding invoice (credit posted to the following recurring invoice) as a goodwill concession for extended terms.

If BigBank needs Net30 for all invoices and requires no credit, we can consider that under a priced discount schedule (2% discount on recurring usage). That would require an approval path from Redwood revenue ops and a signed amendment.

Invoice labeling samples (please use verbatim):
- Line item: "Redwood Platform — recurring usage — route: <model>/<env> — PO: <PO#>"
- Onboarding invoice description: "Redwood Implementation — Onboarding Fee — Project: <project code> — PO: <PO#>"

We will also attach a completed W-9 and vendor remit details in our DocuSign bundle if that helps speed AP processing.

Happy to take the commercial conversation offline if you want numbers/discount modeled — Vivek and I can run that with RevOps.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (stub)

From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@bigbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@bigbank.com
Date: 2026-09-10T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details + invoicing cadence (BigBank PO process)

Vivek / Rishi —

Thanks — BigBank accepts Option A as described. Procurement will issue PO #BG-2026-987654 for recurring platform charges (please ensure that PO number appears on every weekly invoice header). We will route onboarding to capital project CP-33210; please issue a separate onboarding invoice (description per your template) referencing CP-33210 and PO BG-2026-987654.

Attached is the PO PDF (PO_987654.pdf). Please confirm receipt and send the W-9 and remit address to procurement@bigbank.com so AP can whitelist Redwood in our vendor portal. Monica (CC'd), can you take the onboarding kickoff once legal confirms the SOW sign-off?

I'll expect a confirmation email with the vendor remit details and the SOW/DocuSign link for signature.

Regards,
Samantha

Attachments: PO_987654.pdf
